verdicts.decision_note: The failed Amazon upload establishes the implementation-relevant acceptance condition that the cover PDF must be processed and uploaded successfully.
First concrete failure: Amazon rejected the latest cover PDF during an actual upload attempt.
The client requests a smaller PDF export to reduce transfer or processing failures, changing the required executable deliverable without leaving stale attributes.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports producing the requested smaller PDF while preserving print quality.
First concrete verification: the client successfully uploaded the larger cover PDF to Amazon and confirms the smaller export remains available as a backup.
